nodes.description: Private owner address state variable declared in Ownable; controls privileged access.
Public mapping(address => address) of approved plugins, written by approvePlugin.
Internal view function returning msg.sender as address payable.
Internal view function returning msg.data as bytes.
Public view getter returning the current _owner address.
onlyOwner function that sets _owner to address(0), removing ownership.
onlyOwner function that transfers ownership to newOwner after a zero-address check.
Constructor that initializes _owner to the deployer obtained via _msgSender.
onlyOwner function that whitelists a plugin in the approvedPlugins mapping.
Caller-controlled address used for owner initialization and onlyOwner access checks.
Address parameter naming the plugin to approve in approvePlugin.
Address parameter naming the new owner in transferOwnership.
Local variable holding _msgSender() result inside the constructor.
State write approvedPlugins[plugin] = plugin performed inside approvePlugin.
State write _owner = newOwner performed inside transferOwnership after the zero-address require.

edges.reason: _msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value to its caller.
The deployer address derived from msg.sender becomes the initial privileged _owner.
Result of _msgSender() is assigned to the constructor local variable msgSender.
Local msgSender is written into the privileged _owner state variable.
Constructor invokes _msgSender() to obtain the deployer address.
Constructor performs the privileged write that establishes contract ownership.
owner() reads and returns the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership writes address(0) into the privileged _owner variable.
onlyOwner modifier on renounceOwnership compares _owner against _msgSender().
msg.sender controls whether the onlyOwner renounceOwnership call succeeds.
transferOwnership writes the new owner into the privileged _owner variable.
onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership compares _owner against _msgSender().
msg.sender controls whether the onlyOwner transferOwnership call succeeds.
The newOwner parameter is consumed as the input argument of transferOwnership.
The caller-supplied newOwner parameter is stored as the new privileged _owner.
transferOwnership reaches the state write that reassigns _owner.
newOwner flows into the state write operation _owner = newOwner.
The plugin parameter is the input consumed by approvePlugin.
approvePlugin reaches the state write that records the approved plugin.
plugin parameter flows into the state write approvedPlugins[plugin] = plugin.
The approvePlugin state write mutates the approvedPlugins mapping.
msg.sender controls whether the onlyOwner approvePlugin call succeeds.
onlyOwner modifier on approvePlugin compares _owner against _msgSender().
The transferOwnership state write updates the privileged _owner storage slot.

normalization_plan.reason: The plugin parameter has no independent dataflow beyond being written into approvedPlugins inside approvePlugin, so it can be folded into that function node.
The newOwner parameter is only used by transferOwnership (zero-address check and _owner assignment) and carries no standalone semantics.
The msgSender local variable is a transient alias of _msgSender() used solely inside the constructor to set _owner.
